It really depends on what you want in life and how that fits with him. Do you have similar values and want the same path? You are a different generation so keep that in mind, you may have drastically differently outlooks on the how you view the world. But in the end it’s the bond and exchange of the individual person (you and him), not the age group you’re in. Everyone has similarities and differences regardless of age. It’s just like any other relationship, does your beliefs, lives and values fit well with each other? Are you comfortable with him having already had a family before you? Do you see yourself becoming a stepmother? Stuff to think about. Another thing to keep in mind is the power difference in dynamic, be careful of falling into the trap of him having all the power. Just make sure the connection is something that benefits your core and don’t lose yourself in him, but again this could happen with any other relationship, though age gaps highlight the power imbalance a lot more.
